calendars.title:
The legal holidays of Oregon (ORS 187.010(1)) add no day
`us-federal-holidays` does not already close: each enumerated day is a
federal holiday on the same day, observed as § 6103(b)(1) observes it
(ORS 187.010(2)), and every Sunday is closed by `weekend`. The calendar
is declared, empty, so the District of Oregon's bankruptcy count (core's
`frbp9006-oregon`) names the state whose FRBP 9006(a)(6)(C) days it
reads. Not modeled: the days the Governor appoints (ORS 187.020), which
no vendored source lists.

hours.inaccessibleText: FRBP 9006(a): the clerk's office is inaccessible during the last hour; extend to the same time on {date}
hours.rollText: FRBP 9006(a): the period ends on a weekend or legal holiday; continue to the same time on {date}
hours.text: FRBP 9006(a): count every hour from the trigger; +{n} hour(s)

months.text: FRBP 9006(a): count {n} {unit} {after} the anchor to the corresponding day, else the last day of that month -> {date}

periods.text: FRBP 9006(a): count {n} calendar day(s) {after} the anchor -> {date}
FRBP 9006(a): count {n} court day(s) {forward}, skipping weekends and holidays -> {date}
FRBP 9006(a): count {n} business day(s) {forward}, skipping weekends and holidays -> {date}

backward.text: FRBP 9006(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

forward.text: FRBP 9006(a): the last day is a weekend or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

steps.backwardText: FRBP 9006(a): service extensions apply to forward periods only; ignored
